_comment: Vendors that refuse automated requests, read by hand from the same pricing page the automated path would have used. Same fields, same sourceUrl, same discipline: only figures literally shown on the page, nulls where the page does not say. These render on the site marked 'read manually' and are tagged extraction:'assisted' in the dataset. Kept out of build-pricing-index.mjs so a hand-entered figure can never be mistaken for a scraped one. Re-read these whenever the index is rebuilt; there is no automated staleness check on them.

make.notes: Prices are shown against a credit-volume slider defaulting to 10k credits/mo and rise with it. Annual price not shown as a figure, only 'Save 15% or more'.
